summary.text: Eddie Wagoner is the Democratic candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 82, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where the Republican nominee is incumbent David McCormick.
He is an attorney in Morgantown.

paragraphs.text: Wagoner earned a high school diploma from Hudson High School, a bachelor's degree from Columbia University in 2003, and a law degree from The Ohio State University in 2007.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up near Cleveland, moved to West Virginia after law school, and practices in a small firm in Morgantown.
He said he lives there with his wife and two children, who attend Monongalia County public schools.
Wagoner said in the survey that public education is his first priority and that he wants to grow the economy from the bottom up.
He also named protecting individual rights and listed education, civil justice reform, and energy and environment as his policy interests.
